## Checklist

- [ ] I previewed the change with `npm run dev`.
- [ ] `npm run check:docs` passes.
- [ ] Every statement matches what the API or MCP server does today.
- [ ] Examples use fictional data (Northwind Traders, `example.com`, made-up ids), and there are no API keys, tokens or customer data.
- [ ] The copy follows the [writing style](../README.md#writing-style): sentence case, no em dashes.
- [ ] I did not edit generated files by hand (`api-reference/openapi.json`, `mcp/tools/`, `llms.txt`, generated groups in `docs.json`). Maintainers: I ran `npm run build` and `npm run check`.
